newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Corp sets 1997 capex at 30 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Corp sets 1997 capex at 30 bln pesos.

text.p: Ayala Corp said on Friday it was planning total capital expenditure of 30 billion pesos in 1997.
It will be funded through both equity as well debt, president Jaime Augusto Zobel de Ayala told shareholders at the annual meeting.
Last year, the conglomerate had allocated 20 billion pesos for its capital budget.

For this year, 10 billion pesos of the capital expenditure will go to Ayala Land. It will be spent for land acquisition, equity investments in units, building construction and development of commercial centers.
Major expenditures are also being set aside for other units engaged in water, telecommunications, banking, health care and insurance, Ayala said.
